settings.occasions_help: Turn each one on or off. Next dates are worked out live in the forum's timezone ({timezone}). Preview shows the forum as if it were that day; only you see it.
settings.festoon_help: Festoon is installed, so dates it knows come from Festoon and the two always agree.
settings.people_help: Members set their birthday in Settings. Birthdays and join anniversaries get the big moment, a badge for the day and wishes.
settings.datlechin_help: Birthdays come from the Birthdays extension (datlechin), with its privacy choices.
settings.milestones: Celebrate join anniversaries on milestone years only (1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30)
settings.forum_birthday_help: Leave empty to use the day the first member joined.
settings.effects_help: Members who prefer reduced motion never see moving effects, and tunes never play without a tap.
settings.once_a_day: Show the big moment once a day per member (then it waits behind the header button)
settings.quiet_help: No bursts or moving effects in these hours, in the forum's timezone. The moment still shows. Leave empty for none.
settings.timezone_help: The forum's day starts at midnight here. Empty uses Festoon's timezone, then the server's.
